I created the missing `docs/revenue.png`, so the README's `![Monthly revenue](docs/revenue.png)` now points at a real file. I didn't open the PNG to check how it looks.

The chart is a line plot of monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` (12 months). I generated it with matplotlib, since `src/charts.py` only returns the data series and doesn't draw anything. The styling (blue line, markers, grid) is my own choice.

I didn't change the README, and nothing is committed. The repo has no script that regenerates the image, so it won't update if the CSV changes. I can add one if you'd like.
